Guide.userSubtitle: Learn how to maximize master prompt creation, channel management, and subscription features.
Guide.adminSubtitle: Operational guidelines for user registration approvals, payment verification, plan schemes, and AI moderation.
Guide.section1Content: Use the Generator menu to create content ideas, video scripts, social media captions, and image prompt instructions (Image Prompt Studio) tailored to your channel profile.
Guide.section2Content: You can register channels within your subscription limits. The Used Titles Directory feature allows CSV/JSON export/import to prevent duplicate topics.
Guide.section3Content: Select a plan in the Billing menu and upload bank transfer proof. Once uploaded, Superadmins will verify and activate your subscription status.
Guide.section4Content: The top notification bell notifies you of payment status, account approval, subscription expiration, and channel lock state changes.
Guide.adminSec1Content: New users require Superadmin approval in the Registrations menu before gaining login access to the platform.
Guide.adminSec2Content: Review bank transfer proof in the Payment Approvals menu. Click Approve to automatically activate the user's plan and unlock channels.
Guide.adminSec3Content: In System Settings, you can configure global system instructions, default speech rates, and banned words that automatically block illegal generation requests.
